name: Incinerate
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level druid 2, magus 2, ranger 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration see text
Saving Throw Fortitude partial (see text); Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the temperature around the target to raise quickly, setting them on fire. The target takes 1d6 points of fire damage + 1 point per caster level (maximum +10). The target must then make a Fortitude save or be set on fire 1 round per caster level. The DC to put out the fire is the spell’s save DC. After the duration, the DC reverts to the normal DC for putting out a fire. If in an area of cold or winter weather, or if the creature has the cold or water subtype, they gain a +5 bonus on the saving throw.
